title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1984-04-29
lineage: Playback Sony UCX-S cassette masters on Sony TC-D5m to Marantz PMD-670
source: Set 2 only; Master: 2 Crown PZM-315 Microphones and Sony TC-D5m Cassette Master microphones spread about 20 feet behind stage, obstructed view seating;

ai_review.summary: A well‑balanced, good‑sounding recording that captures a solid, relaxed Dead show.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the audio for its excellent balance and clear separation, noting the pleasant behind‑stage perspective that gives the set a chill vibe. The performance itself is described as a standard but strong set with good playing throughout, making it an enjoyable listen despite the lack of any standout moments mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive 4‑star reviews highlight both high recording quality and a good, relaxed performance; no major criticisms were noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Excellent balance and instrument separation; behind‑stage perspective adds clarity and a relaxed ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Standard set list with solid playing; overall feel described as chill, relaxed and enjoyable.
